guarantees.claim: Unless overridden by a state case, all outputs take default values: hmac_hash_done=0, hmac_sha_rvalid=0, clr_txcount=0, load_txcount=0, update_round=0, round_d=Inner, fifo_wsel_o=0, fifo_wvalid_o=0, clr_fifo_wdata_sel=1, sel_rdata=SelFifo, hash_start=0, hash_continue=0, hash_process=0, st_d=st_q.

When in StIdle, if hmac_en_i && reg_hash_start_i, st_d = StIPad, clr_txcount=1, hash_start=1; else if hmac_en_i && reg_hash_continue_i, st_d = StMsg, load_txcount=1, hash_continue=1; else st_d remains StIdle.
In StIPad, sel_rdata = SelIPad; if txcnt_eq_blksz, st_d = StMsg and hmac_sha_rvalid=0; else st_d = StIPad and hmac_sha_rvalid=1.

In StMsg, sel_rdata=SelFifo, fifo_wsel_o=(round_q==Outer). The FSM transitions to StWaitResp when (Inner && reg_hash_process_flag || Outer) && txcount>=sha_message_length_o, asserting hmac_sha_rvalid=0 and hash_process=(round_q==Outer), or when txcnt_eq_blksz && txcount>=sha_message_length_o && reg_hash_stop_q (Inner), asserting hmac_sha_rvalid=0. Otherwise stays in StMsg with hmac_sha_rvalid = fifo_rvalid_i.
In StWaitResp, hmac_sha_rvalid=0; if sha_hash_done_i, for round_q==Outer st_d=StDone, else (Inner) st_d=StDone when reg_hash_stop_q else StPushToMsgFifo; else st_d=StWaitResp.

In StPushToMsgFifo, hmac_sha_rvalid=0, fifo_wsel_o=1, fifo_wvalid_o=1, clr_fifo_wdata_sel=0; transition to StOPad (with clr_txcount=1, update_round=1, round_d=Outer, hash_start=1) occurs when fifo_wready_i && the fifo_wdata_sel_o matches the expected last word index for the given digest_size_i; else st_d=StPushToMsgFifo.
In StOPad, sel_rdata=SelOPad, fifo_wsel_o=1; if txcnt_eq_blksz, st_d=StMsg and hmac_sha_rvalid=0; else st_d=StOPad and hmac_sha_rvalid=1.
In StDone, st_d = StIdle and hmac_hash_done = 1.
For any state not explicitly listed, st_d = StIdle.
guarantees.cond: st_q not in {StIdle, StIPad, StMsg, StWaitResp, StPushToMsgFifo, StOPad, StDone}

assumptions.claim: txcnt_eq_blksz will be asserted after exactly one block of the IPad data has been transmitted to the SHA engine, allowing progression from StIPad.
assumptions.risk: If txcnt_eq_blksz never becomes true, the FSM will hang indefinitely in StIPad, blocking the HMAC operation.

assumptions.claim: txcnt_eq_blksz will be asserted after exactly one block of the OPad data has been transmitted, allowing progression from StOPad.
assumptions.risk: Stall in StOPad prevents outer hash computation and completion of HMAC.

assumptions.claim: The SHA engine will assert sha_hash_done_i after the hash operation triggered by hash_start or hash_process is complete.
assumptions.risk: Without sha_hash_done_i, the FSM hangs in StWaitResp, never reaching StDone or StPushToMsgFifo.

assumptions.claim: The external logic correctly increments fifo_wdata_sel_o so that it matches the last word index (e.g., 7 for SHA2_256, 15 for SHA2_512, 11 for SHA2_384) when all digest words have been written into the FIFO.
assumptions.risk: If fifo_wdata_sel_o does not reach the required value, the FSM will never transition to StOPad, causing a deadlock.

assumptions.claim: The FIFO will eventually assert fifo_wready_i when the last digest word is being written (or on subsequent cycles), allowing the transition out of StPushToMsgFifo.
assumptions.risk: Stall in StPushToMsgFifo if the FIFO never accepts the write, preventing progression to outer pad and completion.

assumptions.claim: The signals txcount, sha_message_length_o, txcnt_eq_blksz, round_q, reg_hash_process_flag, and reg_hash_stop_q are correctly maintained by external logic to reflect the current message progress and host wishes.
assumptions.risk: Incorrect transitions, premature exit, or hang. For example, if sha_message_length_o is wrong, the FSM may move to StWaitResp too early or never.

uncertain_points.claim: In StMsg, when round_q==Inner, reg_hash_process_flag=0, reg_hash_stop_q=0, the FSM may have no path to StWaitResp even after all message data has been transmitted (txcount >= sha_message_length_o and txcnt_eq_blksz may be true). This could cause a deadlock if neither flag is asserted.
uncertain_points.cond: st_q == StMsg, round_q==Inner, reg_hash_process_flag=0, reg_hash_stop_q=0, message sending completed
uncertain_points.risk: The HMAC FSM hangs, never finishing the inner hash and never completing the HMAC.

uncertain_points.claim: The condition to exit StPushToMsgFifo only matches three specific (fifo_wdata_sel_o, digest_size_i) pairs; if digest_size_i takes any other value (e.g., misconfiguration), the equality condition never holds and the FSM will hang.
uncertain_points.cond: st_q == StPushToMsgFifo, digest_size_i not in {SHA2_256, SHA2_384, SHA2_512}
uncertain_points.risk: The HMAC core becomes permanently stuck, unable to complete the HMAC operation, with no error recovery.

uncertain_points.claim: The exit condition from StPushToMsgFifo is an exact equality match on fifo_wdata_sel_o. If the external counter overshoots the target value (e.g., due to an extra write), the condition will never become true.
uncertain_points.risk: The FSM hangs in StPushToMsgFifo, causing a deadlock.

uncertain_points.claim: In StMsg, when round_q==Inner and reg_hash_process_flag is set, the transition to StWaitResp uses txcount>=sha_message_length_o without checking txcnt_eq_blksz. This may prematurely start the hash processing before the full last block is pushed to SHA.
uncertain_points.cond: st_q == StMsg, round_q==Inner, reg_hash_process_flag=1, txcount reaches sha_message_length_o but txcnt_eq_blksz=0
uncertain_points.risk: The SHA engine might receive a partial final block and produce an incorrect digest if the design intent required always finishing the block boundary before hash_process.
